    level="1"
    right="Feat 10"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Gathering Moss](/Feats.aspx?ID=4180) <actions string="Free Action" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Archetype" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=12" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
<trait label="Necromancy" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=117" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Highhelm](/Sources.aspx?ID=204) pg. 111

**Archetype** [Stalwart Defender](/Archetypes.aspx?ID=205)

**Frequency**
once per day

**Prerequisites**
[Stalwart Defender Dedication](/Feats.aspx?ID=4172)

**Requirements**
You are in Tenacious Stance.

</column>

---

By rooting yourself in place, you are able to focus your body's natural healing to work faster. You gain [fast healing](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=15) equal to your level. This fast healing remains for 1 minute or until you end your Tenacious Stance, whichever comes first.
